blocks.text: CAGAYAN DE ORO CITY — Local supporters of the anti-political dynasty law through a People’s Initiative (PI) have called on people in Northern Mindanao to sign the online campaign. Representatives from the Church, academe, civil society, youth and student organizations, and professionals launched the Dapat Isa Lang (D1L) Movement at Xavier University (Ateneo de Cagayan) here last week. D1L has launched a nationwide campaign to pass an anti-political dynasty law through PI, which bypasses Congress, the body that makes and enacts laws, and is mostly dominated by the same families the movement seeks to remove from holding perpetual public office.
